title: Anton and Tree
statementMd:
Anton is growing a tree in his garden. In case you forgot, the tree is a connected acyclic undirected graph.

There are $*n*$ vertices in the tree, each of them is painted black or white. Anton doesn't like multicolored trees, so he wants to change the tree such that all vertices have the same color (black or white).

To change the colors Anton can use only operations of one type. We denote it as $*paint*(*v*)$, where $*v*$ is some vertex of the tree. This operation changes the color of all vertices $*u*$ such that all vertices on the shortest path from $*v*$ to $*u*$ have the same color (including $*v*$ and $*u*$). For example, consider the tree

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a61536a42589f4c98c17f33145edb9e979d29fce.png)

and apply operation $*paint*(3)$ to get the following:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c63b72d85822234bdf1a1fd962be251afd42e3ba.png)

Anton is interested in the minimum number of operation he needs to perform in order to make the colors of all vertices equal.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*color*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *color*_{*i*} ≤ 1$) — colors of the vertices. $*color*_{*i*} = 0$ means that the $*i*$-th vertex is initially painted white, while $*color*_{*i*} = 1$ means it's initially painted black.

Then follow $*n* - 1$ line, each of them contains a pair of integers $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$) — indices of vertices connected by the corresponding edge. It's guaranteed that all pairs $(*u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*})$ are distinct, i.e. there are no multiple edges.

## Output

Print one integer — the minimum number of operations Anton has to apply in order to make all vertices of the tree black or all vertices of the tree white.

## Note

In the first sample, the tree is the same as on the picture. If we first apply operation $*paint*(3)$ and then apply $*paint*(6)$, the tree will become completely black, so the answer is $2$.

In the second sample, the tree is already white, so there is no need to apply any operations and the answer is $0$.
statementZhMd:
Anton 正在他的花园里种一棵树。别忘了，树是一种连通无环无向图。

树中有 $*n*$ 个顶点，每个顶点被涂成黑色或白色。Anton 不喜欢五颜六色的树，因此他想改变这棵树，使所有顶点的颜色都相同（全黑或全白）。

为了改变颜色，Anton 只能使用一种操作，记作 $*paint*(*v*)$，其中 $*v*$ 是树中的某个顶点。该操作会改变所有满足以下条件的顶点 $*u*$ 的颜色：从 $*v*$ 到 $*u*$ 的最短路径上的所有顶点（包括 $*v*$ 和 $*u*$）颜色都相同。例如，考虑下面的树：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a61536a42589f4c98c17f33145edb9e979d29fce.png)

执行操作 $*paint*(3)$ 后得到：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c63b72d85822234bdf1a1fd962be251afd42e3ba.png)

Anton 想知道，为了使所有顶点颜色相同，他至少需要执行多少次操作。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$）——树中顶点的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*color*_{*i}$（$0 ≤ *color*_{*i} ≤ 1$）——各顶点的颜色。$*color*_{*i} = 0$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个顶点初始时为白色，$*color*_{*i} = 1$ 表示其初始时为黑色。

接下来有 $*n* - 1$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*u*_{*i}$ 和 $*v*_{*i}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i}, *v*_{*i} ≤ *n*$，$*u*_{*i} ≠ *v*_{*i}$）——对应边所连接的顶点编号。保证所有顶点对 $(*u*_{*i}, *v*_{*i})$ 互不相同，即不存在重边。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——为了使树中所有顶点变为黑色或所有顶点变为白色，Anton 至少需要执行的操作次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，树与图片中的树相同。如果先执行操作 $*paint*(3)$，再执行操作 $*paint*(6)$，整棵树将变为黑色，因此答案为 $2$。

在第二个样例中，树已经全部为白色，因此无需执行任何操作，答案为 $0$。
